bio: Keisha Lance Bottoms (née Lance; born January 18, 1970), also known by her initials KLB, is an American attorney and politician who is the governor-elect of Georgia. A member of the Democratic Party, she served from 2018 to 2022 as the 60th mayor of Atlanta and from 2010 to 2018 as a member of the Atlanta City Council, representing part of Southwest Atlanta.
offices: Senior Advisor to the President of the United States (2022–2023)
